import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

def get_left (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ l _ => some l
  | _ => none

def get_right (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => some r
  | _ => none

def get_val (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v _ _ => some v
  | _ => none

def BinarySearchTree.is_node (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzig_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t ∧ 
  BinarySearchTree.is_node t ∧ 
  (match get_left t with 
   | some p => BinarySearchTree.is_node p ∧ 
               (match get_left p with 
                | some x => BinarySearchTree.is_node x 
                | none => False)
   | none => False)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def zigzig (t : BinarySearchTree) 
    (h_precond : zigzig_precond t) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node g (BinarySearchTree.Node p (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c) d =>
      BinarySearchTree.Node x a (BinarySearchTree.Node p b (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d))
  | t' => t'
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzig_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : zigzig_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∧
  -- Structural properties: X (grandchild) is now root
  get_val result = get_val (get_left (get_left t).get!).get!
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem zigzig_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (h_precond : zigzig_precond t) :
    zigzig_postcond t (zigzig t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  rcases t with _ | ⟨g, L, d⟩
  · simp [BinarySearchTree.is_node, get_left] at h_precond
  rcases L with _ | ⟨p, X, c⟩
  · simp [BinarySearchTree.is_node, get_left] at h_precond
  rcases X with _ | ⟨x, a, b⟩
  · simp [BinarySearchTree.is_node, get_left] at h_precond
  have hz : zigzig (BinarySearchTree.Node g
        (BinarySearchTree.Node p (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c) d) h_precond
      = BinarySearchTree.Node x a (BinarySearchTree.Node p b (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d)) :=
    rfl
  have hbst : is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node g
      (BinarySearchTree.Node p (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c) d) := h_precond.1
  have hLg : ∀ y ∈ view (BinarySearchTree.Node p (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c), y < g :=
    hbst.1
  have hL : is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node p (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c) := hbst.2.1
  have hdg : ∀ y ∈ view d, y > g := hbst.2.2.1
  have hd : is_bst d := hbst.2.2.2
  have hXp : ∀ y ∈ view (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b), y < p := hL.1
  have hX : is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) := hL.2.1
  have hcp : ∀ y ∈ view c, y > p := hL.2.2.1
  have hc : is_bst c := hL.2.2.2
  have hax : ∀ y ∈ view a, y < x := hX.1
  have ha : is_bst a := hX.2.1
  have hbx : ∀ y ∈ view b, y > x := hX.2.2.1
  have hb : is_bst b := hX.2.2.2
  have hpg : p < g := hLg p (by simp [view])
  have hxp : x < p := hXp x (by simp [view])
  have hcg : ∀ y ∈ view c, y < g := by
    intro y hy
    exact hLg y (by simp only [view, Set.mem_union]; exact Or.inl (Or.inr hy))
  have hbp : ∀ y ∈ view b, y < p := by
    intro y hy
    exact hXp y (by simp only [view, Set.mem_union]; exact Or.inl (Or.inr hy))
  have hGp : ∀ y ∈ view (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d), y > p := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with (hy | hy) | hy
    · exact hcp y hy
    · exact lt_trans hpg (hdg y hy)
    · subst hy; exact hpg
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hz]
    refine ⟨hax, ha, ?_, hbp, hb, hGp, hcg, hc, hdg, hd⟩
    intro y hy
    simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with (hy | hy) | hy
    · exact hbx y hy
    · have hyp : y > p := by
        apply hGp
        simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        exact hy
      exact lt_trans hxp hyp
    · subst hy; exact hxp
  · rw [hz]
    ext y
    simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    tauto
  · rw [hz]
    simp [get_val, get_left]
  -- !benchmark @end proof

`LEAN VERIFIED` on check 2/15. `Solution.lean` is complete, with changes confined to the `code` and `proof` marker regions (auxcode and lemma left empty).

**Implementation** (`zigzig`): pattern-matches the zig-zig shape `G(P(X(a,b), c), d)` and returns `X(a, P(b, G(c,d)))` — X at the root, P as its right child, G as P's right child. A catch-all returns `t` unchanged; those branches are unreachable and are discharged from the precondition in the proof.

**Proof** structure:
- `rcases` on `t`, its left child, and its left-left grandchild; the three degenerate cases contradict `zigzig_precond` (via `is_node`/`get_left` reducing to `False`).
- In the real case, `hz : zigzig … = Node x a (Node p b (Node g c d))` holds by `rfl`, so each postcondition conjunct rewrites to a concrete tree.
- The BST facts are destructured from `h_precond.1` into per-subtree bounds, giving `x < p` and `p < g` from the fact that `p` and `x` are members of their parents' views.
- **BST invariant**: `a < x` and `is_bst a` carry over directly; the new right spine needs `b < p`, `c < g`, elements of `Node g c d` exceeding `p` (by cases on `c`/`d`/`g` with transitivity through `p < g`), and everything in the right subtree exceeding `x` (chaining through `x < p`).
- **Set preservation**: `ext y` plus unfolding `view` reduces both sides to the same disjunction of memberships, closed by `tauto`.
- **Structural**: `get_val` of the result matches `get_val (get_left (get_left t).get!).get!` by `simp`.
